name: yard-fittings-verify
description: YARD-FITTINGS: the service yard's washing-machine bib tap raised to 1.15 m (above the 0.85 m machine instead of buried inside it), its braided inlet hose down to the machine's top-back, the corrugated drain hose around the machine into the floor trap, and the ceiling-mounted retractable laundry rack (two brackets, three aluminium poles on hanger cords at 2.05 m). Walk poses at Realistic, 13:00, lights on, then the serviceYard room editor (walk BEFORE the editor, never after — entering walk from the editor leaves that room's walls stale-faded). Probes the yard fitting instance counts and the tap's world AABB against the washer's own box. Run with SHOT_GPU=1. Pair with the same scenario at SHOT_URL='http://localhost:5200/?ff=yardFittings:off' for the before frames.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: probe-yard
steps.eval: (() => { const inst = []; let tubes = 0, groups = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.name !== 'yard-fittings') return; groups++; o.traverse(c => { if (c.isInstancedMesh) inst.push({ geo: c.geometry.type, count: c.count, color: c.material && c.material.color ? '#' + c.material.color.getHexString() : null }); else if (c.isMesh) tubes++ }) }); const r = { flag: window.__store.getState().featureFlags.yardFittings, groups, tubes, inst }; console.log('[probe] yard', JSON.stringify(r)) })()

steps.name: probe-tap-vs-washer
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); const it = st.items.find(i => i.defId === 'washing-machine'); const w = it ? { x: it.position[0], z: it.position[1], rot: it.rotation, w: 0.6, d: 0.6, h: 0.85 } : null; const yard = { x0: 4.705, x1: 6.125, z0: 6.875, z1: 9.075 }; const pts = []; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.name !== 'plumbing-fittings') return; o.traverse(c => { if (!c.isInstancedMesh) return; const a = c.instanceMatrix.array; for (let i = 0; i < c.count; i++) { const x = a[i*16+12], y = a[i*16+13], z = a[i*16+14]; if (x > yard.x0 && x < yard.x1 && z > yard.z0 && z < yard.z1 && y > 0.5) pts.push([x, y, z]) } }) }); const bb = pts.length ? { x: [Math.min(...pts.map(p=>p[0])), Math.max(...pts.map(p=>p[0]))], y: [Math.min(...pts.map(p=>p[1])), Math.max(...pts.map(p=>p[1]))], z: [Math.min(...pts.map(p=>p[2])), Math.max(...pts.map(p=>p[2]))] } : null; const inWasher = w ? pts.filter(p => Math.abs(p[0]-w.x) < w.w/2 && Math.abs(p[2]-w.z) < w.d/2 && p[1] < w.h).length : -1; console.log('[probe] tap', JSON.stringify({ washer: w, tapParts: pts.length, tapBounds: bb, partsInsideWasherBox: inWasher })) })()

steps.name: pose-yard-south
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(5.4, 7.3); l.setYaw(3.1416); l.setPitch(-0.25) })()

steps.name: pose-yard-up
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(5.4, 8.2); l.setYaw(3.1416); l.setPitch(0.75) })()

steps.name: pose-yard-down
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(5.4, 7.9); l.setYaw(3.1416); l.setPitch(-0.9) })()

steps.name: pose-yard-north
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(5.4, 8.6); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(0.35) })()

steps.name: probe-editor
steps.eval: (() => { const inst = []; let tubes = 0, groups = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.name !== 'yard-fittings') return; groups++; o.traverse(c => { if (c.isInstancedMesh) inst.push({ geo: c.geometry.type, count: c.count }); else if (c.isMesh) tubes++ }) }); console.log('[probe] editor yard', JSON.stringify({ groups, tubes, inst })) })()
